confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live listings or menus. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately confident for a small Peruvian tourist village. Hotel and hostel anchors are less certain because oasis lodging varies widely by property, season and booking channel. July is high season, so prices are set at the upper-normal end of the range. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the local beer and pisco-sour price relationship.
comparable_city_reasoning: Comparable to small Peruvian tourist destinations on the south coast and near Ica (for example Paracas) and Peruvian backpacker towns, with prices adjusted for Huacachina's oasis tourism premium. Not based on a named city dataset.
